title: Dispatch Optimizer: route planning in minutes, not mornings
subtitle: How Northwind Digital Works replaced spreadsheet route planning for a 14-warehouse freight network.
client_line: Calloway Freight Group · Rotterdam · 14 warehouses in NL, BE and DE
challenge_intro: Dispatchers built routes in a spreadsheet every morning, and drivers left the yard with paper manifests that were often already out of date.

challenges.title: Slow mornings
challenges.text: The previous tool needed 15 to 20 minutes every morning to build routes in a spreadsheet.

challenges.title: Outdated paperwork
challenges.text: Drivers said paper manifests were frequently outdated by the time they left the yard.

challenges.title: Hard rules
challenges.text: Routes had to respect time windows, EU driver break rules and vehicle capacity limits.

brief: Plan better routes faster, and keep drivers working even without a connection.
solution_intro: We built a routing engine, a map-first dispatcher dashboard and an offline-first driver app, piloted at the Antwerp and Ghent warehouses.

pillars.title: Constraint-aware routing
pillars.text: Google OR-Tools solves the vehicle routing problem with time windows, breaks and capacity.

pillars.title: Map-first dashboard
pillars.text: Dispatchers see the map first, with a collapsible list of routes on the left.

pillars.title: Works offline
pillars.text: Drivers keep working without a connection for up to 8 hours, then sync.

pillars.title: Built for the cab
pillars.text: High-contrast design and 48-pixel buttons for use in strong sunlight.

steps.title: Orders in
steps.text: Stops and delivery windows arrive from the client's SAP system

steps.title: Dispatcher review
steps.text: Adjust routes on the map-first dashboard

steps.title: Drive and deliver
steps.text: Scan, sign and photograph proof of delivery

outcomes.title: Adopted on day one
outcomes.text: 96.2 percent of drivers logged in successfully on the first day.

outcomes.title: Phase 2 signed
outcomes.text: A follow-up contract extends the system to 9 more warehouses in France and Spain.

quote.text: The first software delivery in five years that the dispatchers asked to keep using instead of requesting changes to.
quote.who: Henrik de Vries, operations director, Calloway (paraphrased)

conclusion: Faster planning, fewer late deliveries and a phase 2 contract: built step by step with the people who use it every morning.
